idea-plugin.name: Monokai Sublime 3
idea-plugin.description: Monokai Sublime 3 — a custom color scheme for PhpStorm and other JetBrains IDEs, based on the classic Monokai/Sublime Text palette. Also available as a full IDE theme (toolbars, menus, tool windows, etc.), with UI colors adapted from the Neokai (Classic) theme.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0: Added a full IDE theme variant — editor colors stay Monokai Sublime 3, but the surrounding IDE chrome (toolbars, menus, panels) now picks up a matching dark palette adapted from Neokai (Classic).
1.0.0: Initial release (editor color scheme only).
